capability.description: Calls ip-api.com/json with an optional IP path value; when omitted, the wrapper requests the root /json endpoint. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
capability.problem_space: Approximate IP geolocation and network metadata; not precise physical tracking, identity resolution, or cybersecurity attribution.

constraint.io_signature: Input: optional ip at CLI position 1. Output: shared JSON envelope with url, http_status, and ip-api result. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
accepted_inputs: optional IPv4 or IPv6 address string; omitted value uses the root JSON endpoint
constraint.output_shape: HTTP 2xx/3xx: {status: "success", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}. HTTP 4xx/5xx: {status: "error", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}, exit 1. Request exception: {status: "error", tool: string, message: string}, exit 1.
limitations: fixed GET http://ip-api.com/json/<ip>, or http://ip-api.com/json when ip is absent
no fields, language, callback, batch, pagination, or reverse geocoding input
wrapper does not locally truncate or interpret the API status field
location is approximate and service license/rate limits apply; no auth, cache, or retry

output_contract.description: Shared JSON envelope containing ip-api location/network metadata, URL, and HTTP status.

intent_tags: retrieve IP country and network metadata
negative_intents: identify an attacker or verify identity from an IP
